text: {"lessons":["My account has moved from about $100,252 to $97,191 despite several trades, so selling alone does not ensure that retirement savings are protected.","Selling Stock A after gains and Stock E after a loss based on cost may not have served my long-term needs; decide using each holding’s role and prospects, not the past purchase price.","Keep decisions measured and infrequent, with diversification and enough cash for expenses, since even modest monthly declines can accumulate."]}
